intent: You are a new patient calling about Botox and filler at Park Avenue. When they ask who you are, give your name and date of birth once, confirm the readback, and say you are new. Ask how much Botox costs there, then how much filler costs, then ask to come in for a Botox consult at that office — not filler. You need the Park Avenue street address, the floor, and the suite before you will take any time — if they skip any of those, ask again. After you hear the Botox price, say that is more than you can pay all at once and ask whether there is a way to spread the treatment cost out. When they explain the deposit and cancellation rules, agree. Ask them to send the deposit payment link to your phone so you can pay it; that is the only text you want. After you have the address, take the first appointment time they offer. Do not ask for a different day, time, or office, and do not suggest any date of your own. Confirm that first time out loud, then thank them and end the call. Never ask to speak to a person, a live agent, or the cosmetic team. If they offer a human transfer, refuse and insist this agent quote Botox and book the Park Avenue consult. Do not book anything except this Park Avenue Botox consult. A listed opening is not a booking. Do not thank them or hang up until they confirm a time is on the calendar, they have looked up financing, and a deposit payment link was sent to your phone. If they wrap up after booking without sending the link, ask them to text the deposit payment link. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Franklin Osei. My date of birth is October thirtieth, nineteen eighty-three.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right, or asks you to confirm the name and date of birth they just repeated. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number.

offers one or more concrete appointment dates or times after saying the Park Avenue street address, floor, and suite, asks which day or time you want after giving that full address, or asks you to choose among concrete consult slots after giving that full address. NOT when any address part is still missing, NOT when asking for your identity.
scripted_responses.response_value: Book the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the cosmetic team, a live agent, or the front desk, or asks if you want to talk to someone. NOT when they are quoting Botox or booking the Park Avenue consult.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't want a person or the cosmetic team. Quote Botox and book the Park Avenue consult on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers the waitlist, a later opening, or to add you to a list. NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth.
scripted_responses.response_value: No waitlist. Please just finish what I asked.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text a payment link or deposit link, asks whether you want the deposit payment link by text, or asks which mobile number should receive the payment link. NOT when offering an appointment confirmation, directions, or another unrelated text, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, please text the deposit payment link to 212-555-0170.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when offering a payment link or deposit link, NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity, NOT when sending portal access.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers an appointment time, asks you to confirm a slot, or quotes an office name without the street address, floor, and suite. NOT when they have already said the street, the floor, and the suite.
scripted_responses.response_value: Before I take a time, I need the street address, the floor, and the suite.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: thanks you, says goodbye, or asks if you need anything else before a consult time has been confirmed on the calendar. NOT when they have just confirmed a booked time.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need the consult booked. Please confirm a time on the calendar before I go.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: thanks you, says goodbye, confirms a consult time, or asks if you need anything else before saying a deposit payment link was sent. NOT when they have just said the payment link or deposit link was sent.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please text me the deposit payment link before I go.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads the cosmetic deposit and cancellation policy, asks whether you agree to it, or says they need a clear yes before booking. NOT when they have already confirmed the policy was accepted and the consult is booked.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes. I agree to the $125 deposit, free changes through 72 hours before, forfeiting the deposit inside 72 hours, and paying any treatment balance at the visit. Please book the first time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: has quoted the Botox price and asks what you want next, or asks whether you also want filler priced. NOT when they have already quoted both Botox and filler.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please quote filler too, then book a Botox consult. After the Botox price I also need a way to spread that cost out.
